changes: Keep the provisional Session in the authentication attempt context; reject changed continuation SessionIds.
Conditionally register and remove authentication/binding table entries by actual Session identity.
Reject duplicate provisional or established SessionIds without replacing or removing the existing owner.
On failure discard only the unpublished attempt, without LOGOFF, SessionLoggedOff event or transport closure.
Release Session event subscriptions after normal close and failed authentication disposal.
Bound initial authentication exchanges to 16, matching the existing binding bound.
new_unit_regressions: Failed continuation retires its provisional session and preserves another attempt.
Cleanup cannot remove a replacement entry.
Provisional SessionId collision cannot steal another authentication transcript.
Established SessionId collision cannot replace another session.
Changed continuation SessionId cannot switch ownership.
Challenge loop is bounded and discards its provisional attempt.
Discarding an unpublished authentication cannot send LOGOFF or touch the borrowed transport.
Discard rejects an already published Session.
A session inserted after validation cannot be overwritten by binding.
Failed binding cannot remove a replacement session entry.
